messages:
leah_sales: Heads up — BankBridge (POC next week) asked for a written confirmation they can keep all customer data in the EU for the duration of the POC. they want details on routing, subprocessors, and what happens if we hit capacity.

sam_presales: short answer: for hosted we can prefer eu-region endpoints and pin tenant to eu-west region, but we need to call out subprocessor egress for monitoring/analytics. also note fallback behavior if capacity exhausted (we reroute to nearest compatible region unless customer requests strict pin).

maria_security: @leah_sales +1. For legal/security we can produce an attestation PDF that lists subprocessors and routing constraints. but: unless they purchase Dedicated/Private, DR backups may be replicated cross-region for disaster recovery. must they accept that?

leah_sales: BankBridge specifically asked "no cross-border data movement at all" during the POC. is Dedicated the only path to guarantee that?

ryan_ops: Dedicated or Private gives isolation. On hosted we can set region affinity + soft pinning, but not an absolute guarantee — autoscale and egress to telemetry vendor may cross to us-west. ops note: we can also run a temporary tenant-peering for the POC to reduce surface area.

sam_presales: propose this wording for the scoping doc: ```
{"routing_policy": "eu-only-affinity", "primary_region": "eu-west-1", "allowed_subprocessors": ["AWS eu-west-1", "LogStream-EU"], "fallback": "no-cross-border-with-dedicated"}
```

maria_security: That JSON is fine for internal scoping but legal wants a plain sentence: "During the POC we will process and store data in EU regions only. Hosted tier will use EU affinity; backups and third-party telemetry may be processed outside the EU unless customer opts for Dedicated or Private deployment." add: "We will provide the subprocessors list and a completed vendor attestation."

leah_sales: ok. can we get exact subprocessors list for the scoping doc and an estimate for incremental cost if they insist on Dedicated for the POC? they asked cost per seat + minimum monthly.

ryan_ops: subprocessors (short): AWS (eu-west-1), CloudNet-EU (monitoring), LogStream-EU (logs), KeySafe (KMS-eu). I'll DM infra_bot to generate the full export. Dedicated pricing: rough estimate +25% on top of hosted baseline for the POC timeframe, depends on GPU sizing.

infra_bot: export ready: /s3/exports/bankbridge_poc/subprocessors_2026-03-18.csv : includes contact and SCCs.

leah_sales: perfect, I'll add infra export to the scoping doc and ping legal for the attestation PDF. thanks everyone, will update customer. :thumbsup:

maria_security: if they require contractual EU-only processing we must escalate to legal for SLA clause + encryption key custody ask (BYOK will be a blocker without Private). flagging.

sam_presales: noted. next steps: leah to share scoping doc with estimated Dedicated uplift and subprocessors list, legal to draft attestation + clause. we'll follow up in this thread.

leah_sales: moving to draft now. ETA EOD today. any objections?

ryan_ops: no objections. small ops caveat: if they test with long context lengths, default kernels may bump capacity — include burst policy in the doc.

leah_sales: added. closing loop once doc shared.
